Jamie — thanks for the note and the heads-up to procurement. I pulled together the current MAP checkpoint summary and attached the compact benchmark PDF and the MAP timeline spreadsheet. TL;DR: we are on track for a 2026-11-30 target provided the canary completes without regression in the next 48–72 hours.

Summary of perf results (eval run: v2.3-cached, 8k context, mixed-precision quantized):
- p50 latency: 92 ms
- p95 latency: 170 ms
- p99 latency: 285 ms
- tokens/sec (steady-state, batch=8): 1,600 tok/s per GPU
- Observed KV-cache hit rate during our replayed workload: 28% (saves ~14% compute cost)

Notes on setup/assumptions:
- Test cluster: 4xA100 40GB, model variant: rdx-13b-q4f16, warm-up 300 tokens
- Traffic profile: 65% chat-like (short turns), 35% long-generation tails (avg 850 tokens)
- Batch sizing auto-tuned during run; steady-state was batch=8 for latency SLOs

Key items from this week's run and recommended tuning next steps:
1) Prefetch KV-caching for common prefixes — owner: Marcus Lin. ETA: 11/20. Expected impact: reduce p95 by ~10–12% on chat flows.
2) Adjust batching policy threshold to allow opportunistic batch expansion during 200–500 ms idle windows — owner: Ben Carter. ETA: 11/22. Expected impact: lower cost by ~8% without breaking p50 goals.
3) Quantization profile tweak for tail-generation kernels (reduce quant noise) — owner: Monica Patel. ETA: 11/24. Expected impact: slight latency increase (~+10 ms p50) but ~18% compute reduction for long tails.

Attachments included: flux_benchmark_v2.pdf (compact run summary), MAP_v3_timeline.xlsx (action tracker + milestones).

Quick action list for procurement/close:
- Confirm procurement review window (Jamie) — due: 11/18 EOD.
- Finalize SLO appendix for contract (Priya) — due: 11/22.
- Sign-off on canary rollback policy (Marcus) — due: 11/23.

Full notes and the raw run graphs are in the attached PDF. If helpful we can run a short 30-min sync with procurement + eng tomorrow.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0194

Adding a couple of datapoints from the infra/tuning side — I ran the prefetched KV prototype on a subset of the replay and saw: p95 drop from 170ms to 150ms on chat flows (approx 11.7% improvement), p99 unchanged. The patch currently lives on the canary lane; I will promote it after we confirm stability.

Additional tuning items (owner + short plan):
- Marcus Lin: finalize KV-prefetch rollout scripts; safety gate: memory regression < 3% across 95th percentile; ETA 11/20.
- Ben Carter: implement opportunistic batch scaler — will instrument a guardrail to avoid batch expansion for heavy long-tail requests; ETA 11/22.
- Monica Patel: run quantization A/B on tail kernels vs control for quality checks; will produce eval delta report by 11/24.

On canary timeline: current plan is a 48-hour canary (live traffic) with automated rollback on any >2% increase in user-facing error/timeout rates. If canary passes by 11/21 we can schedule a controlled rollout to the dedicated pool on 11/23 and complete contract ops by 11/30.

"Acceptance criteria" suggestion for procurement wording: include the canary gate and a 7-day SLA credit window in the SLO appendix. I can draft the short paragraph if helpful.

Marcus
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
